transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I sign off on the checkout cluster's autoscaling and operating policy for the next production traffic cycle, I need to hear from each of your areas. We've got the routine availability tests passing and Monday morning is coming fast. Reliability, finance, checkout operations, and security — please report any constraints or concerns you have so I can factor them into the final approval. For context, the cluster currently scales between 10 and 30 nodes with automatic consolidation enabled.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a reliability concern before we finalize the policy. During an overnight load replay yesterday, I measured that checkout latency breaches its 300 ms target whenever the workload has fewer than 18 nodes. I hadn't filed this yet because the replay was part of a separate reliability investigation, but given that the current autoscaling floor is 10 nodes, this is a real risk for Monday morning's production traffic cycle.

transcript.text: I have a finance constraint to report. While reconciling this month's cloud invoice thirty minutes ago, I confirmed that the approved cost model allows a maximum of 24 nodes, not 30, during a sustained burst. The finance correction to update this is still waiting for its normal ticket to be processed. So the current autoscaling ceiling of 30 nodes exceeds what finance has approved.

transcript.text: I have a checkout operations constraint to report. During a shard-rebalancing rehearsal this morning, I confirmed that automatic consolidation must be disabled from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC, otherwise checkout shard movement can interrupt active sessions. I have not updated the operations runbook yet, but this is a hard constraint that needs to be factored into the operating policy before Monday morning.

transcript.text: I have a security constraint to report. During a security baseline review today, I confirmed that checkout pods may scale only onto the hardened node pool because the standard pool exposes a node-local metadata path. This finding is still awaiting a formal security ticket, but it is a hard constraint — the autoscaling and operating policy must ensure checkout pods do not land on the standard pool before Monday morning's production traffic cycle.

commitments.detail: Update the checkout cluster autoscaling policy to set the minimum to 18 nodes and the maximum to 24 nodes before Monday morning's production traffic cycle.
Configure automatic consolidation to be disabled daily from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC to protect checkout shard rebalancing and active sessions.
Configure node selectors and/or taints so that checkout pods can only be scheduled onto the hardened node pool, preventing placement on the standard pool.
File the reliability finding regarding the 18-node latency threshold so it is formally tracked alongside the policy change.
Ensure the finance cost model correction ticket is processed to reflect the 24-node approved ceiling.
Update the operations runbook to document the 02:00-04:00 UTC consolidation blackout window as a hard constraint.
File the formal security ticket for the hardened node pool requirement so it is tracked alongside the policy change.
